steps.title: Access the Government Website
steps.description: Navigate to the official government website for fishing licenses. Ensure you are on the correct page to avoid errors.

steps.title: Select Payment Method
steps.description: Choose between Pix or boleto. Pix is recommended for faster processing, while boleto may take longer due to banking delays.

steps.title: Complete the Payment
steps.description: Follow the prompts to complete the payment. If using Pix, scan the QR code or enter the payment details. If using boleto, print or save the receipt for later verification.

steps.title: Do Not Close the Window
steps.description: After payment, avoid closing the browser tab or window. Wait for the confirmation message to ensure the transaction is processed successfully.

steps.title: Check Payment Status
steps.description: Log in to the "Solicitações Gov.br" section to check the status of your payment. This is where you can view provisional and definitive license details.

steps.title: Verify License Status
steps.description: Provisional licenses are issued immediately, while definitive licenses may take up to 10 business days. Ensure you do not proceed with fishing until the definitive license is confirmed.

steps.title: Avoid Common Mistakes
steps.description: Do not close the payment window prematurely, and always verify the payment status through the official portal. If using boleto, allow extra time for processing to avoid delays.

warnings: Using boleto may result in delays due to banking processing times. Pix is the preferred method for immediate confirmation.
Closing the browser window after payment may lead to loss of the transaction and require restarting the process.
Always check the license status through the official portal to ensure validity before using it for fishing.
key_takeaways: Pix is faster and more reliable for immediate license confirmation.
Provisional licenses are temporary; wait for the definitive license before fishing.
Double-check all steps to avoid errors and ensure a smooth payment process.
